highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and ships source-authored XML API documentation with managed assemblies.
highlights_body: It corrects native glyph-atlas and GPU failure handling. Review the HarfBuzzSharp enum migrations and the removal of RAW/DNG decoding before upgrading.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class spelling corrected
breaking.body: Replace UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with CCC132. The numeric value remains 132; no compatibility alias is retained.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz aggregate glyph flag removed
breaking.body: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags required by your application instead. The aggregate BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined masks are not introduced.

breaking.title: Built-in RAW and DNG decoding removed
breaking.body: RAW/DNG development and extraction of embedded JPEG previews are no longer supported. Use a separate RAW decoder or convert files before loading them. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains its value of 10 for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Includes upstream Ganesh clipping, Graphite triangle-strip, and SVG color-filter improvements while preserving existing C exports.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz enum values match the bundled engine
bullets.detail: Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1. Callback-heavy API families and new unwrapped native types remain excluded.

bullets.lead: API documentation travels with reference assemblies
bullets.detail: NuGet packages include matching compiler XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, making source-authored API guidance available to package consumers.

bullets.lead: Glyph-atlas updates and failed GPU work handled consistently
bullets.detail: Avoids stale glyph-atlas reuse and propagates failed prerequisite flushes through existing null/false contracts. Failed uploads drop affected draws, and failed flushes clear uniquely held cache entries.

bullets.lead: Uno WebAssembly uses matching HarfBuzz native assets
bullets.detail: The Uno views package depends on the matching HarfBuzz WebAssembly assets rather than an older implicit archive missing required symbols.

bullets.lead: Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007
bullets.detail: Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Corrected Windows HarfBuzz warning suppression so consuming applications pass BinSkim BA2007

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the Skia m154 line while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added packaged compiler XML, synchronized HarfBuzz enums, and corrected glyph-atlas, GPU-upload, Windows BinSkim, and Uno WebAssembly issues.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: The release candidate removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

harfbuzz_summary: Synchronizes supported enums with native HarfBuzz 14.2.1, correcting CCC133 to CCC132 and removing GlyphFlags.Defined. Adds source-authored compiler XML and fixes Windows BinSkim BA2007 and Uno WebAssembly native-asset matching; the .400 package revision does not upgrade the engine.
